matrix_note: Researched against Bifrost v1.6.4 source (tag transports/v1.6.4); the pinned image is v1.6.6 and these cells have not been re-researched against it. v1.6.4 has no openai-chat -> responses bridge and no gemini/cohere/bedrock-format ingress. Its Anthropic-Messages ingress is the drop-in route /anthropic/v1/messages, which converts to a Responses request for the provider the model name resolves to, so from anthropic ingress the openai-responses column and the anthropic diagonal are declared; anthropic ingress into gemini/cohere/bedrock has not been researched and is not claimed. Undeclared cells are grey on that basis
name: bifrost
untestable_note: Researched against Bifrost v1.6.4 (the pinned image is v1.6.6; not re-verified against it): v1.6.4 hardcodes the Bedrock host (bedrock-runtime.<region>.amazonaws.com, core/providers/bedrock/bedrock.go; network_config.base_url never overrides it), so the harness mock cannot stand in for the upstream; Bifrost does serve Bedrock Converse in production
